label: maindcthm
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{maindcthm}
Let $\mathbf{M}=(M_j)_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\in\mathbb{R}_{>0}^{\mathbb{N}}$ be a log-convex sequence such that $\mathbf{M}_{\iota}=\lim_{j\rightarrow+\infty}(M_j)^{\frac{1}{j}}=+\infty$ and let $p\in[1,+\infty)$. Then the following are equivalent:
\begin{itemize}
\item[$(i)$] The spaces $\mathcal{E}_{\{\mathbf{M}\}}$ (Roumieu-type) and/or $\mathcal{E}_{(\mathbf{M})}$ are/is derivation closed.

\item[$(ii)$] $\mathbf{M}$ satisfies
$$\exists\;D\ge 1\;\forall\;j\in\mathbb{N}:\;\;\;M_{j+1}\le D^{j+1}M_j.$$

\item[$(iii)$] $\mathbf{M}$ satisfies
$$\exists\;C\ge 1\;\forall\;j\in\mathbb{N}:\;\;\;M_j\le C^{j^2+1}.$$

\item[$(iv)$] $\mathbf{M}$ resp. the corresponding sequence of roots satisfies
$$\exists\;A\ge 1\;\forall\;j\in\mathbb{N}_{>0}:\;\;\;(M_{j+1})^{\frac{1}{j+1}}\le A(M_{j})^{\frac{1}{j}}.$$

\item[$(v)$] The sequence of quotients $\mu=(\mu_j)_{j\in\mathbb{N}_{>0}}$ satisfies
$$\exists\;D\ge 1\;\forall\;j\in\mathbb{N}:\;\;\;\mu_{j+1}\le D^{j+1}.$$

\item[$(vi)$] The sequence of quotients $\mu=(\mu_j)_{j\in\mathbb{N}_{>0}}$ satisfies
$$\exists\;A\ge 1\;\forall\;j\in\mathbb{N}_{>0}:\;\;\;\mu_{j+1}-\mu_j\le A^j.$$

\item[$(vii)$] The sequence of quotients $\mu=(\mu_j)_{j\in\mathbb{N}_{>0}}$ satisfies
$$\exists\;h'>h>0:\;\;\;\sum_{j=1}^{+\infty}\left(\frac{h}{h'}\right)^{pj}(\mu_{j+1}-\mu_j)<+\infty.$$

\item[$(viii)$] The counting function $\Sigma_{\mathbf{M}}$ satisfies
$$\liminf_{t\rightarrow+\infty}\frac{\Sigma_{\mathbf{M}}(t)}{\log(t)}>0.$$

\item[$(ix)$] The associated function $\omega_{\mathbf{M}}$ satisfies
$$\liminf_{t\rightarrow+\infty}\frac{\omega_{\mathbf{M}}(t)}{(\log(t))^2}>0.$$

\item[$(x)$] The associated function $\omega_{\mathbf{M}}$ satisfies
$$\exists\;h'>h>0:\;\;\;\int_{0}^{+\infty}e^{p\omega_{\mathbf{M}}(ht)-p\omega_{\mathbf{M}}(h't)}dt<+\infty.$$

\item[$(xi)$] The associated function $\omega_{\mathbf{M}}$ satisfies
$$\exists\;A\ge 1\;\exists\;B>0\;\forall\;t>0:\;\;\;\omega_{\mathbf{M}}(t)+\log(t)\le\omega_{\mathbf{M}}(At)+B.$$
\end{itemize}
All listed assertions are preserved under equivalence of log-convex sequences.
